backup.production_rule: replace with a fresh immutable production restore point during an owner-approved privacy cutover window

forward_verification.name: privacy_tables_exist
forward_verification.query: select to_regclass('public.privacy_requests') is not null and to_regclass('public.privacy_holds') is not null and to_regclass('public.privacy_action_audit') is not null

forward_verification.name: privacy_tables_are_private
forward_verification.query: select not has_table_privilege('anon','public.privacy_requests','select') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.privacy_requests','select') and not has_table_privilege('service_role','public.privacy_requests','select')

rollback.safe_until: before any production privacy request or hold is created; after writes, retain rows and apply a forward fix or restore the approved production restore point

steps.name: disable_privacy_entry_points
steps.action: revoke authenticated EXECUTE on the three privacy RPCs; do not drop private tables or audit rows

steps.name: preserve_review_records
steps.action: retain existing request, hold and audit rows while the forward fix is prepared

steps.name: restore_only_if_no_valid_writes_can_be_preserved
steps.action: use the approved immutable production restore point; never run a destructive down migration after request or hold writes

feature_flags.name: privacy_rpc_production_access
feature_flags.required_state: off until owner MFA, legal/privacy review and staffed smoke verification

compatibility.evidence: 49/49 focused pgTAP assertions and 15/15 database test files pass in disposable recovery

stop_conditions: production migration ledger differs from source
fresh immutable production restore point is absent
owner/admin smoke session is not aal2
current Philippine privacy and retention review is not recorded
any forward verification query differs from its expected result
a migration or smoke test attempts automatic deletion or anonymization
